sngl:ui

sngl:ui The user interface: the components most applications are built from, and the vocabulary they share. What is here is the portable core -- a `button` means the same thing on the web, on a phone, in a desktop toolkit and in a terminal, and a platform that renders it differently still renders the same declaration. Specialised surfaces live in packages under this one, so that a program pays for a drawing canvas or a document viewer only by importing it: sngl:ui/draw a canvas and the 2D shapes it hosts The components fall into five groups: display show a value and do not edit it form controls the user edits, each with a two-way bound value prop layout containers, which place their children nav move the user somewhere else overlay paint above the rest of the tree `node` is the family all five belong to, and `window` is the surface they are placed on -- the one member of `root`, the family a package body accepts. The two are here rather than in an application-shell package of their own because a window is where widgets go: what it hosts is `node`, so any package holding it would import this one and be imported back. `Style`, the style enums and the event payloads sit here rather than in a package of their own because every component in every one of those packages refers to them; they are the vocabulary, not a separate concern. Nothing here is in scope until it is imported. `import <alias> "sngl:ui"` qualifies its declarations (`alias.vbox`), and is also how a platform overrides a component (`component <alias>.vbox`); it is the form this repository writes. `import . "sngl:ui"` writes them unqualified and remains supported. Components
  • avatar User profile image with fallback.

  • button Clickable button that triggers an action.

  • checkbox Boolean toggle rendered as a checkmark box.
  • chip Compact interactive tag.
  • datepicker Calendar-based date selection.
  • divider Visual separator line.
  • drawer Slide-out panel anchored to a side of the viewport.
  • hbox Horizontal box layout container.
  • image Displays an image from a URL or asset path.
  • input Single-line text input field.
  • link Navigational hyperlink.
  • menu Context or dropdown menu.
  • menubar Horizontal menu bar — typically at the top of a window on desktop.
  • modal Dialog overlay.

  • popover Floating content panel anchored to a trigger.
  • progress Progress indicator.

  • table Tabular data display.

  • textarea Multi-line text input field.
  • toggle On/off switch control.
  • toolbar Horizontal bar of action buttons.
  • tooltip Informational popup on hover or focus.
  • tree Hierarchical data display.
  • vbox Vertical box layout container.
  • window A top-level window — a surface the user sees, which a program creates and destroys with the tree.
    • Types
  • ChangeEvent Payload emitted by `@change` when a control commits a new value — typically on blur, Enter, or an explicit selection change.
  • ClickEvent Payload emitted by `@click` when a component is activated.
  • DateEvent Payload emitted by `@change` from `datepicker` when the selected date changes.
  • DismissEvent Payload emitted by `@close` for overlay components (modal, drawer, popover, chip remove).
  • ExpandEvent Payload emitted by `@expand` in hierarchical views such as `tree` when the user opens or collapses a node.
  • FocusEvent Payload emitted by `@focus` and `@blur` as focus moves in and out of a control.
  • InputEvent Payload emitted by `@input` on every keystroke.
  • LoadEvent Payload emitted by `@load` after an asynchronous resource (image, document) finishes loading.
  • LongPressEvent Payload emitted by `@longPress` after a sustained press on pointer or touch platforms.
  • MenuEvent Payload emitted by `@select` / `@close` on menu and menubar items.
  • RefreshEvent Payload emitted by `@refresh` when a scrollable container requests pull-to-refresh.
  • ResizeEvent Payload emitted by `@resize` when a split or resizable container changes geometry.
  • ScrollEvent Payload emitted by `@scroll` / `@scrollEnd` as the viewport scrolls.
  • SelectEvent Payload emitted by `@select` from list-like components (tabs, tree, table row selection).
  • Style Declarative style properties applied via the `style` prop on any visual component.
  • SubmitEvent Payload emitted by `@submit` on form-style input submission, typically triggered by pressing Enter inside a single-line input.
  • ToggleEvent Payload emitted by `@change` from `checkbox` and `toggle`.

  • Alignment Cross-axis alignment of children inside a flex container.
  • BorderStyle Line style drawn along a component's border.
  • Display Intrinsic layout mode.
  • FlexDirection Main-axis direction for flex containers such as `vbox` and `hbox`.
  • FontStyle Slant applied to fonts.
  • FontWeight Numeric weight for fonts.
  • Justification Main-axis distribution of children inside a flex container.
  • ListStyle Marker style for list-rendered containers.
  • ObjectFit How an `image`'s contents are sized to fit its frame.
  • Overflow Behavior when content exceeds its container's bounds.
  • Position Positioning scheme for a component within its parent's layout flow.
  • TextAlign Horizontal alignment of inline text content.
  • WhiteSpace Whether a host collapses runs of whitespace in a component's text, and where it may break a line.
